passages.quote:
Zero-hours contracts are also known as casual agreements.

If you employ someone on a zero-hours contract:

you do not have to give them work

they do not have to work when you ask them

Zero-hours workers are entitled to statutory annual leave and the National Minimum Wage in the same way as regular workers.

You cannot do anything to stop zero-hours workers from getting work elsewhere. The law says they can ignore a clause in their contract if it bans them from:

looking for work

accepting work from another employer

You are still responsible for the health and safety of workers on zero-hours contracts.
